body.title: Medical Image Segmentation Labels
body.scope: Pixel-level segmentation of anatomical structures across a set of anonymized scans. Each page contains one image; mark the required regions per the guideline rubric and flag any low-quality scans for review.
guidelines: Use the provided label set only; do not invent new classes.
Boundaries must follow the structure edge within 2px tolerance.
Ambiguous cases: add a note rather than guessing.
